ranked_findings.problem: H2O proxy initialization overwrites real attention history when a short or incremental stream first exceeds budget.
ranked_findings.impact: Changes H2O decisions for every token-by-token PPL stream crossing its first capacity and short-prompt generation. The usual long-prefill six-task headline initializes before real decode feedback, so that specific path is unaffected. SnapKV internal H2O first decode also has real feedback before its first initialization.
ranked_findings.minimal_fix: Preserve real cumulative history; only create proxy initialization when no real score history exists.
ranked_findings.disposition_at_record_time: Sent to root; no reviewer implementation edits.

ranked_findings.problem: Tiered attention is billed from post-insertion/post-eviction hot residency, baseline from pre-forward past length. Both must describe the observed forward with the new causal row.
ranked_findings.impact: Analytical attention bill differs for identical attended caches and is missing the current row at saturation. At normal 1024-row hot saturation this is a small per-step error; migration counts, quality and measured GPU timing are unaffected.
ranked_findings.minimal_fix: Use old exposed hot count plus current input count, old exposed cold count; price post-forward migrations separately. Baseline uses past length plus current input count.
ranked_findings.disposition_at_record_time: Root plans fix only after its in-flight frozen-source GPU jobs finish; their analytical fields need explicit invalidity while quality can remain separately usable.

ranked_findings.problem: RunMetrics.summary always uses two bytes per element for hot/cold resident footprints, independent of configured storage precision.
ranked_findings.impact: FP32 bytes underreported by factor two before display rounding; FP8 cold bytes overreported by factor two. Current headline does not consume these summary fields; uses are parity/hash diagnostic drivers.
ranked_findings.minimal_fix: Carry hot and cold element sizes into RunMetrics and use them for each corresponding footprint.
ranked_findings.disposition_at_record_time: Sent to root; no reviewer implementation edits.

ranked_findings.problem: Standalone sketch is billed from post-eviction cold count with max(count,1), so it invents a page read when there were no cold rows or sketch operations.
ranked_findings.impact: Standalone simulator only. LongBench harness has no sketch path, so its headline, quality and real GPU timing are unaffected. Post-step page count also misaligns nonempty sketch event billing.
ranked_findings.minimal_fix: Capture actual pre-sketch page count and allow zero.
ranked_findings.disposition_at_record_time: Sent to root; no reviewer implementation edits.

reviewed_boundaries.cold_read_scope: Rows exposed during the completed model forward are charged as cold even if they become shadows/promoted afterward. Newly restored shadow/live metadata does not add another attention read.
reviewed_boundaries.migration_scope: Separate post-forward payload migration charges remain meaningful under the declared analytical event boundary; logical backup restores incur no payload rewrite.
reviewed_boundaries.mixed_precision: One CostModel bytes_per_elem is insufficient for hot/cold mixed storage. Already explicitly documented experimental limitation; FP8 energy claims must remain invalid rather than be interpreted as physical.
reviewed_boundaries.cost_arithmetic: Primitive GB/s to microsecond, pJ/bit to nJ, and promote/demote directions are mathematically consistent. Initial placement, interface/compute/system power and leakage are explicitly excluded or separate.
reviewed_boundaries.baseline_scope: In-harness SnapKV and H2O remain adapted proxy-prefill baselines; faithful SnapKV selector is separate. No claim of upstream-faithful algorithm replication inferred.
reviewed_boundaries.historical_headlines: Logical writes_saved/(writes_saved+paid_writes) counter aggregation remains correct within stated decode-demotion event scope; corrections above do not change that ratio.

limitations: Observed outputs were obtained with inline CPU commands prior to this saved reusable script. Script body reproduces their logic; no claim of a new saved-script execution is made. Findings are ranked by relevance to currently active outputs, not potential hypothetical future benchmarks.
